title: Plant Manager
text:
Ameron Pole Products, an Arcosa subsidiary, is searching for a Plant Manager for our plant in Fillmore, California. The Plant Manager is responsible for forecasting and leading with results, increasing market revenue, streamlining/standardizing workflow and creating a collaborative team environment to increase productivity and develop a culture of respect and empowerment. Responsibilities for this role will also include identifying and driving continuous improvement efforts, optimizing inventory, increasing plant capacity, improving process planning capabilities, driving short- and long-term continuous improvement, delivery performance and mix flexibility with the goal of achieving manufacturing excellence as Best-in-Class.
 
 
**What You'll Do**

* Oversee employee and plant safety to ensure OSHA and company policy compliance
* Develop and administer budgets and activities to fund operations, maximize investments and increase efficiency
* Oversee safety, quality, production, maintenance, distribution and cost accounting
* Direct and manage resources to implement tactical business plans and programs to see work through completion
* Communicate the vision, strategy and objectives for the plant effectively
* Set clear and consistent expectations for performance and leverage resources available to accomplish goals
* Follow up on critical tasks and hold people accountable for adhering to processes and protocols
* Partner with maintenance department and vendors/contractors to coordinate preventive maintenance requirements to ensure machinery and mechanical equipment is operational
* Stage work and recalibrate throughout the day as necessary to meet customer demands
* Identify talent and show ownership of all aspects of plant staffing and retention
* Exhibit a strong work ethic and focus on Lean Manufacturing, safety, quality, productivity and P&L management
* Coordinate and communicate with the project management, purchasing and engineering departments to align resources and coordinate work.

**What You'll Need**

* Minimum of 5 years’ experience managing overall operations (safety, quality, procurement, logistics, maintenance, budget, etc.) in an engineered-to-order manufacturing environment
* Bachelor’s degree
* Experience in an industrial steel manufacturing plant preferred
* Experience with moderate to complex project management involving materials and manufacturing processes in a steel fabrication environment
* Experience with moderate to complex operations with products on manufacturing lines including cutting steel plate, fitting, welding and outfitting
* Knowledge of machines and tools used for steel fabrication (plasma tables, saws, press brakes, welders, CNC machining), including their designs, uses, repair and maintenance
* Ability to apply quality control for moderate regulatory & testing requirements
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing principles and practices
* Experience working in a union environment is preferred.

Compensation - $121,900 - $158,470 annually
 
 
Equal Opportunity Employer
